headline: Congress authorized a Congressional Gold Medal to tennis champion Billie Jean King for her work advancing equal rights for women.
what_it_does: This law provides for the award of a Congressional Gold Medal to Billie Jean King. The medal honors her leadership in advancing equal rights for women in sports, schools, and society. Congress awards gold medals as a formal national honor.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on September 26, 2024.
